final: SELECT COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'NULL') as ordermix, COUNT(*) as cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / 1000.0 as share, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / 1000.0 - (1.0 / 3.0) as above_avg_share FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'NULL') HAVING CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / 1000.0 > (1.0 / 3.0) ORDER BY above_avg_share DESC
